title: DNS resolution failures causing intermittent timeouts on cart-service
description: cart-service intermittently fails to resolve cart-cache.redis.svc.cluster.local via CoreDNS: lookups return SERVFAIL/NXDOMAIN or time out, so a fraction of cart reads/writes stall and time out even though the cache itself is healthy. This is a name-resolution pattern, not resource exhaustion — CPU and memory on cart-service are nominal.
